lastCompletedStory.title: cam plan N thin-proxy writes phase:planning + plan_issue instead of injecting markdown

nextStoryContext: US-004 replaced the send-keys /cam-plan injection in runPlan with a state-file write: phase:planning + plan_issue:<id> to .claude/cam-loop.local.md (mirroring runNext's active:true write). Key changes: (1) plan.ts rewrote runPlan to use buildPlanningBody/writeStateFile instead of sendKeysWhenIdle; added selectPlannableIssue from issues/select.ts (new module) with F-01 contract: specific-N validation halts on missing/non-plannable issue (never falls back to top-of-queue). (2) test/plan.test.ts rewrote all tests to assert state-file write semantics (phase, plan_issue fields) and F-01 behavior. (3) test/attach-hint.test.ts fixed to inject readBacklogFn because runPlan in an empty tmpdir now calls readBacklogFromMain which returns []. (4) file-size-budget.json raised plan.ts ceiling. The next story (US-005) reduces cam-plan.md (both .claude/commands/ and templates/commands/ copies) to a thin phase-signal stub (<60 lines), runs bun run embed-vendor to regen the embedded copy, and writes ADR 0006 documenting the phase-enum state machine.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-004 only touches cam-cli internals (plan.ts, next.ts, sidecar.ts, issues/select.ts) and Bun/Node built-ins. No external library exercised.
